tells.1: Over-flattened, stripped-down phrasing. 'Unlocks additional features' is vague filler.
tells.2: Stacked stock benefit phrases: 'guidance you can trust,' 'keep your recovery moving,' 'unlock more of what the app has to offer.'
tells.3: Stock closer 'see how far you've come,' plus a 'so you know what to do and how to do it right' clause.
tells.4: Forced casual register ('bouncing back,' 'tweak your plan,' 'keep you moving forward') that reads like a humanizer pass.
tells.5: Boilerplate trailing clauses: 'keep your recovery moving,' 'get more of what the app has to offer.'

reason: Version 6 has the uneven, template-driven feel of real app-store copy, but its legalese is clunky. Version 3 is the cleanest, clearest and most credible to publish.
